notes.title: "Rage Tower" DEMO Version 0.0.03 - Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700180/1731f44c58b49f93859301cdd8b1fa1b0a32015f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]"Rage Tower" DEMO Version 0.0.03 - Update[/b][/p][p]Here are the main changes made:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed again the issue where the camera would freeze;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed again the issue where the player could get stuck in walls;[/p][/*][/list][p]The game demo may still have some minor issues, and we are actively working to resolve them.[/p]

notes.title: "Rage Tower" DEMO Version 0.0.02 - Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700180/1731f44c58b49f93859301cdd8b1fa1b0a32015f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]"Rage Tower" Version 0.0.02 - Update [/b][/p][p]Here are the main changes made:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the camera would freeze;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the player could get stuck in walls;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game freezing during dialogues;[/p][/*][*][p]Re-adjusted the layout of some levels;[/p][/*][*][p]Sped up the player respawn animation, with an option to quickly skip the death screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]The game demo may still have some minor issues, and we are actively working to resolve them.[/p]
